Read input: rtlpp_09941_combined.v · Open raw
module ALU(ctrl, A, B, shamt, cout, ovf, ze, R);
	input [2:0] ctrl;
	input [31:0] A, B;
	input [4:0] shamt;
	output cout, ovf, ze;
	output [31:0] R;
	
	// ALU operation logic
	reg [31:0] res;
	assign cout = 1'b0;
	assign ovf = 1'b0;
	assign ze = (res == 32'b0);
	assign R = res;

	always @(ctrl or A or B or shamt) begin
		case (ctrl)
			// Example operations
			3'b000: res = A + B; // ADD
			3'b001: res = A - B; // SUB
			3'b010: res = A & B; // AND
			3'b011: res = A | B; // OR
			3'b100: res = A << shamt; // SLL
			3'b101: res = (A < B) ? 32'b1 : 32'b0; // SLT
			default: res = 32'b0;
		endcase
	end
endmodule

module rtlpp_09941 
 (
  input  clk,                      
  input  reset,                    
  output [1:0]  count_o,           
  input  signed [16:0] x_in,       
  output signed [16:0] pre_o,      
  output signed [16:0] x_o,        
  output signed [16:0] post_o,     
  output signed [3:0]  ind_o,      
  output signed [16:0] imm_o,      
  output signed [16:0] a_o,        
  output signed [16:0] f_o,        
  output reg signed [16:0] f_out); 

  
  parameter load=0, mac=1, scale=2, denorm=3, nop=4;
  
  parameter start=0, leftshift=1, sop=2, 
                   rightshift=3, done=4;

  reg [3:0] s, op;
  reg [16:0] x; 
  reg signed [16:0] a, b, f, imm; 
  reg signed [33:0] af; 
  reg [16:0] pre, post;
  reg signed [3:0] ind;
  reg [1:0] count;
  
  wire signed [16:0] p [0:4]; 
  
  assign p[0] = 7563;
  assign p[1] = 42299;
  assign p[2] = -29129;
  assign p[3] = 15813;
  assign p[4] = -3778;
  
  always @(posedge reset or posedge clk) 
  begin : States                      
    if (reset) begin               
      s <= start; 
      f_out <= 0; 
      op <= 0; 
      count <= 0;
      imm <= 0; 
      ind <= 0; 
      a <= 0; 
      x <= 0; 
    end else begin 
      case (s)                 
        start : begin          
          s <= leftshift; 
          ind <= 4;
          imm <= x_in;         
          op <= load; 
          count <= 0;
        end
        leftshift : begin      
          count <= count + 1; 
          a <= pre; 
          op <= scale;
          imm <= p[4];
          if (count == 2) op <= nop;
          if (count == 3) begin 
            s <= sop; 
            op <= load; 
            x <= f; 
          end
        end
        sop :  begin            
          ind <= ind - 1; 
          a <= x;
          if (ind == -1) begin  
            s <= rightshift; 
            op <= denorm; 
            a <= post;
          end else begin
            imm <= p[ind]; 
            op <= mac;
          end
        end
        rightshift : begin 
          s <= done; 
          op <= nop;
        end
        done :  begin          
          f_out <= f;            
          op <= nop;
          s <= start;            
        end                   
      endcase
    end
  end

  always @(posedge reset or posedge clk) 
  begin : ALU             
    if (reset)            
      f <= 0;
    else begin
      af = a * f;
      case (op)
        load    : f  <= imm;
        mac     : f  <= (af >>> 15) + imm;
        scale   : f  <= af;
        denorm  : f  <= af >>> 15;
        nop     : f  <= f;
        default : f  <= f;
      endcase
    end
  end

  always @(posedge x_in)
  begin : EXP
    reg [16:0] slv;
    reg [16:0] po, pr;
    integer K; 

    slv = x_in;
    
    for (K=0; K <= 15; K= K+1) 
      if (slv[K] == 1)
        pre = 1 << (14-K);
    
    po = 1;     
    for (K=0; K <= 7; K= K+1) begin
      if (slv[2*K] == 1)    
        po = 1 << (K+8);

      if (slv[2*K+1] == 1) 
        po = (1<<(K+9)) - (1<<(K+7)) - (1<<(K+5))
              + (1<<(K+3)) + (1<<(K+1)) + (1<<(K-5));
    end
    post <= po;
  end

  assign a_o = a;   
  assign imm_o = imm;
  assign f_o = f;
  assign pre_o = pre;
  assign post_o = post;
  assign x_o = x;
  assign ind_o = ind;
  assign count_o = count;

endmodule
